items.title: My 2027 Goals Journal Coloring
items.alt: An open journal displays My 2027 Goals above three empty star checkboxes and writing lines in black and white.
items.description: Layered page edges, small hearts and a stitched ribbon bookmark frame the blank goal space across the spread.

items.title: Hope in 2027 Mouse and Kite Coloring
items.alt: A smiling mouse holds a heart-shaped kite labeled Hope in 2027 in a black-and-white coloring illustration.
items.description: The mouse’s large ears and long curved tail balance the tall kite, whose string is decorated with small bows.

items.title: 2027 Crown and Party Horn Coloring
items.alt: A tall pointed party crown marked 2027 sits beside a striped horn and two hanging stars in black and white.
items.description: Rounded tips, inset stars and simple decorative bursts create clear coloring spaces across the crown’s wide band.

items.title: Welcome 2027 Navy and Gold Mat
items.alt: A navy semicircular mat displays Welcome 2027 in cream and gold lettering framed by leafy sprigs and a small rising sun.
items.description: Fine fabric texture and a double gold border give the curved welcome graphic a restrained decorative finish.
